audit.why: Every Yone ability costs 0 mana, Mortal Steel is a flat 4s, and Spirit Cleave shields him on 14s scaled by attack speed. Kassadin cannot contest any of that before Riftwalk. TRICKY 7/10 stands against 52.16% over 2088 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spikes[] array was largely incoherent: spikes[0] claimed 'Yone hits 3 items in one Q3 dash-mark reset', spikes[1] called Fate Sealed 'Mordekaiser-ult-lite', spikes[2] opened 'Yone's own Riftwalk (his ult, not literally...)'.
audit.why: Yone's real spikes are Mortal Steel's 4s reset with the Airborne third cast, Soul Unbound falling 22s to 10s across its ranks, and Fate Sealed at 120/100/80s. None of that was on the page.
audit.corrected: All four spikes[] entries rewritten to the real abilities and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields (whys[2], mid, late, wants.foe[3]) credit Yone with WIND WALL. Yone has no Wind Wall — that is Yasuo's W. Yone's W is Spirit Cleave, a cone that shields him.
audit.why: The kit gives Yone W as Spirit Cleave, 14s, 700 range, shield scaling with champions hit. The decisive interaction that IS real and was never stated: Soul Unbound sends his spirit out and 'when this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body' — so the body is a fixed return point, and moving away from it is what breaks the combo. Fate Sealed 'blinks behind the last champion in a line' and pulls, so walking toward him puts you furthest back.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall removed from all four fields; the body-return and the blink-behind-the-last-champion behaviours written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d called Soul Unbound a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — 15s is not a rank it has.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[3] referred to 'your Null Sphere silence engage'. The kit gives Null Sphere no silence.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere is damage, channel interrupt and a magic shield — no silence, and the kit carries no silence flag.
audit.corrected: The clause is gone with the rewrite of that field.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Riftwalk has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1 down to 10s at rank 5, and it drags him back to the body he left; kite away from that body. - Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1 and it is his only peel — make him spend it on nothing.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Riftwalk out the far side of Soul Unbound — his spirit is forced back to the body, so the exit he can chase is the one you never take.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — that is 22s of level-1 freedom.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line — walking at him is how you end up the one furthest back.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yone wins by opening Soul Unbound, landing the Q3 knockup on the return, and killing you before Rod of Ages finishes.

edits.before: Q resets plus Wind Wall let him control the lane tempo and deny your Force Pulse windows.
edits.after: Mortal Steel resets every 4s and Spirit Cleave shields him, so he sets the tempo of every trade.

edits.before: He can chain a full Q1-Q2-Q3-E combo that kills you before your kit comes online.
edits.after: Soul Unbound at 22s plus the Q3 knockup is a full combo before your kit exists.

edits.before: Yone hits 3 items in one Q3 dash-mark reset and can flat-out all-in you off a single landed Null Sphere trade; you have no shield or blink yet, so this window is his to force, not yours.
edits.after: Mortal Steel resets on a 4s cooldown and its third cast dashes him in with a knockup, so he can all-in you off one landed hit; you have no blink yet, so this window is his to force, not yours.

edits.before: Your first Riftwalk lets you blink in, land Force Pulse point-blank for the empowered proc, and blink back out before his Mordekaiser-ult-lite Fate Sealed onto your escape can punish you, so this is where you flip momentum.
edits.after: Your first Riftwalk lets you blink in, land Force Pulse point-blank, and blink back out before Fate Sealed — which blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls — can catch your exit, so this is where you flip momentum.

edits.before: Yone's own Riftwalk (his ult, not literally, but his all-in via Q3 knockup) still threatens burst even through your Seeker's/Rylai's, so you must play around his cooldown rather than sponsoring the R timer war.
edits.after: Soul Unbound drops to 13s at rank 4 and the Q3 knockup still bursts you through Seeker's, so keep playing around that timer instead of trusting an item to hold — your first-item spike is smaller than his.

edits.before: Full-build Kassadin with Rabadon's/Void Staff double-blinks around Yone's Fate Sealed knockup, deletes him before his passive shield resets, and out-scales any bruiser Yone splitpush attempt.
edits.after: Full-build Kassadin with Rabadon's and Void Staff double-blinks out of Fate Sealed's pull, deletes him before Spirit Cleave shields him again on 14s, and out-scales any bruiser Yone splitpush attempt.

edits.before: You hit 6 first in most timelines and that Riftwalk is the reset button — blink in, unload Null Sphere plus a charged Force Pulse, blink out before his Fate Sealed knockup connects; but if he catches you out of position at 4-5 with his Wind Wall blocking your Q, his all-in still kills you outright, so this phase splits between his early kill threat and your post-6 poke leverage.
edits.after: You hit 6 first and that Riftwalk is the reset button — blink in, unload Null Sphere plus a charged Force Pulse, blink out before Fate Sealed pulls you back; but Soul Unbound is only 16s at rank 3, and if he catches you at 4-5 with the spirit out, his Q3 knockup into the snap-back damage still kills you outright, so this phase splits between his early kill threat and your post-6 poke leverage.

edits.before: Once you finish Seeker's into Rabadon's, double Riftwalk lets you dive his backline before his Wind Wall timer is up again, and Yone's lack of a hard peel tool (Wind Wall is reactive, not a knockback) means a clean blink-in from you is close to unanswerable in a 2+ item teamfight.
edits.after: Once you finish Seeker's into Rabadon's, double Riftwalk lets you dive his backline while Soul Unbound sits on its 10s cooldown, and Yone's only peel is Fate Sealed's pull on 80s — so if you make him spend that, a clean blink-in from you is close to unanswerable in a 2+ item teamfight.

edits.before: Splitpush with Wind Wall to neutralize your Null Sphere silence engage
edits.after: Splitpush and make you answer him alone, with your team elsewhere
